attributes.action:
DIVORCE WITHOUT CONTROL
Fairness, Freedom & Wellbeing
attributes.additional_details: This petition calls for legal reform to protect domestic abuse victims trapped in joint mortgages with their abusers. No one should be forced to remain financially tied to an abusive partner because they cannot afford to leave a shared property/mortgage. The Government must introduce a statutory right to financial separation, allowing victims to rebuild their lives without fear, control or intimidation. Escaping abuse should never mean sacrificing your financial future, security or independence.
attributes.background: Protect people from financial abuse during divorce. Prevent unfair mortgage changes, stop financial control by ex-partners, reduce legal costs and delays, and ensure everyone can leave a marriage safely and fairly.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign the following petition, which calls for similar action:

Statutory right for domestic abuse victims to separate from joint mortgages
